# A01-S92: Exhibition proposal

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…] 

This email is only a first part of more talk, which I think we should take 
on the phone. Some of what I want to say is not suitable for writing - and 
you must not take the following as a negative vibe :-)

I like your proposal and your framing of the project as a “Manual 
for Making an Artificial Mind” including exhibition elements 
 - and especially the ongoing participation/publication. And I actually think that you 
and your selected artists should take it as your project; I don’t know 
if I can/should play an active role in it, but I fully support it 
up to presentation for [████] and [████] at our 
upcoming meeting.

My own synopsis is still in note form and based on a 
exhibition/experience of the digital (consumer) technology, as we 
use it today. It is based on GAN (text to images) and has 
workflow[████] The Written Language - Man’s detachment from nature: From 
cave paintings to emojis; and I think of it more "pictorially" than 
text-generated stories [████]. I rather see it as the framework around a 
dedicated interactive public exhibition, where snapshots are saved 
as "artworks". More about that when I have put it together in a 
synopsis - but anyway, I’m sending you a couple of links to 
image generation from OpenAI and a few selected other links for 
perspective, so you can orient yourself a bit in that world.

I am not sure if I myself want to be the sender and organizer of 
that, so we also need to talk about who will do it 
 - including possibly hardware suppliers from [████]' network and/or for example 
some of your or [████]’s contacts? The project is thus not 
text based, but rather a "quick and dirty" exhibition to 
attention about rebooting MF/InQvation. How much of it might 
be included in your project I don’t know yet. And that leads me to 
(our) problem, which is that the ambition level for MF keeps moving 
(that’s the phone talk), and that we don’t have a clear strategy for 
visibility and engagement with an audience.

My ambition about BoM as a self-running dialogue forum and a 
chatroom-like function is more realistic with your project. I think 
we ([████] and I) have now missed the chance with Hello 
Humans a couple of times, and I don't really believe that [████]’s idea of using HH as 
newsletters (with comment sections like advice column editors) will create a 
serious debate in the public about neither MF nor 18. sustainable development goals, but 
of course I want to hear her plan for rebooting InQvation and the 
old MF before I take a position on what BoM and HH end up as (more 
phone talk). Right now I am skeptical and think that the MF vision (the 
original idea) is being reduced to a "Danish event" level 
without international perspectives on either debate about the future or 
future learning.

[████] concerns 18 sustainable development goals and the consideration of it in 
connection with the other UN's 17 SDGs. It is _(geo)politics_ on a global 
scale and not "just" some self-satisfied Danish opinions. What I try to 
express is that the balloon deflates if it ends up being about 
"Danish" industrial interests via the sitting Danish 
interest organizations and their members' relations to the EU system. 
I mean, "who the fuck cares"? [████]

Well, [████], we haven’t come further than our own little agreement to 
try to describe some projects that (maybe) fit into [████]’s 
and [████]' plans for a reboot, which we do not know the extent of before 
[████] . Therefore, I think you should continue 
with your synopsis for the “Manual” project and get it "written down" to 
[████] and [████] level with a clearer description of what is 
the "product" - including how a chatroom could look if it is not 
tied to BoM. We are talking pixie level here, ha-ha. And despite the fact that you have 
tried to restrain yourself into academic language use and explanation of scope 
etc., they will not understand it unless it is cut out entirely in 
paper - i.e. _what do I get for my money, when - and preferably tomorrow_ 
:-)

[…]
